scripts.db:generate: if [ "$NODE_ENV" != "production" ] && [ -f .env.development.local ]; then node --env-file=.env.development.local node_modules/prisma/build/index.js generate; else node node_modules/prisma/build/index.js generate; fi
scripts.db:migrate: if [ "$NODE_ENV" != "production" ] && [ -f .env.development.local ]; then node --env-file=.env.development.local node_modules/prisma/build/index.js migrate deploy; else node node_modules/prisma/build/index.js migrate deploy; fi
scripts.db:seed: if [ "$NODE_ENV" != "production" ] && [ -f .env.development.local ]; then node --env-file=.env.development.local node_modules/prisma/build/index.js db seed; else node node_modules/prisma/build/index.js db seed; fi
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:admin: if [ "$NODE_ENV" != "production" ] && [ -f .env.development.local ]; then tsx --env-file=.env.development.local prisma/seed-admin.ts; elif [ -f .env ]; then tsx --env-file=.env prisma/seed-admin.ts; else tsx prisma/seed-admin.ts; fi
